title: 一度に播くな
change: 人気への期待を作付けへ変える。十二区画の分割播種を始め、初収穫までは仕入れる。
state: 既存の成株を順に使い、復旧区画を播種。最初の庭葉は7日目に播く。28日栽培は見込みで確定値ではない。

sources.description: Diner counter, young adult adventurer with auburn short hair and muted ochre cloak finishes bowl; Elna listens smiling then worried. Small inset empty leafy garnish plate. This recurring customer is not Leon.
dialogue: ありがとう。量を確かめておくね。
sources.scrollPurpose: 導入の場所と前話の状態を引き継ぐ

sources.description: Kou and Elna outside serving window, clean empty harvest basket in foreground; two unequal closeups basket and Kou's thoughtful face. Existing harvest has been used, garden cannot immediately replace it.
dialogue: 一度に採れたら、次は空く。
畑にも、仕込みがいるんだ。
sources.scrollPurpose: 相手の知識を聞いて受け止める

sources.description: Balt on plot path shows tiny native seed in palm, Kou listens close, lower panel glowing ceiling vein and differently shaded bed corner. Plain seed packet without labels.
dialogue: この種は、どんな場所で育つ？
庭葉は、光が弱いと遅れる。
ここで育つ速さを、測ろう。
sources.scrollPurpose: 手順と判断を短い動作でつなぐ

sources.description: Three brief closeups: handful of small seeds; Kou places an equal counted sample on damp cloth in shallow dish; notebook makes tally marks with room for future result. No sprouts already in newly set test, no predicted yield on screen.
dialogue: 全部の種が、芽を出すとは限らない。
同じ数を置いて、出た芽を数える。
sources.scrollPurpose: 気づきの前後で速度を落とす

sources.description: Elevated plot view with FOUR long parallel beds, each divided into THREE equal subsections by small twine markers, total twelve sections; medium Kou and Elna looking at plain sketched plan. Bed widths consistent, no implausible giant farm. Leave words off diagram.
dialogue: 四つの畝を、十二に分ける。
七日ずつ、播く日をずらそう。
採る日も、ずらしたいんだね。
sources.scrollPurpose: 選んだ行動と結果を確かめる

sources.description: Three unequal hand-action panels: Elna makes shallow sowing line in prepared bed; Kou sows tiny seeds in one selected section; soil gently covers seeds. Only first three of twelve sections are sown this week; other sections stay bare or contain existing plants. No germination in same instant.
sources.scrollPurpose: 説明の後に反応を待つ

sources.description: Diner back door, local farmer delivers basket of existing leafy vegetables, Elna and Kou accept and tally purchase. Distinct plain brown-clothed adult supplier, not main cast duplicated. Bought grain sack also visible.
dialogue: 最初の収穫までは、仕入れる。
その代金も、計算に入れよう。
畑が遅れても、店を止めないために。
sources.scrollPurpose: 次の仕事へ状態を渡す

sources.description: Large quiet evening scene under blue awning, Kou and Elna beside notebook with four simple week columns and small drawings, no readable diagram text; tiny new sown beds visible through window at ground, no mature crop there. Their serious hopeful faces dominate.
dialogue: 明日の客と、四週間後の畑。
四週間は、まだ見込みだけど。
じゃあ、毎日確かめよう。
sources.scrollPurpose: 今回の成果を受け止めて次話へ進む
